source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הַגּוֹרָ֜ל לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ מִיַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְמֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָה הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִירִיח֛וֹ בָּהָ֖ר בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out the lot for [the] sons of Joseph from [the] Jordan [of] Jericho to [the] waters of Jericho eastward, the wilderness going up from Jericho in the hill country [to] Bethel.

en.L: And the lot for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Joseph went out from the Jordan at Jericho, to the waters of Jericho on the east, the wilderness going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
en.B: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph ran from the Jordan at Jericho, east of the springs of Jericho, through the wilderness that climbs from Jericho up into the hill country to Bethel.
en.R: Joseph's descendants were given their land by lot. Its southern border started at the Jordan River near Jericho, east of the springs there. From Jericho it climbed through the desert into the hill country and on to Bethel.

sw.L: Na kura ya wana wa Yusufu ilitoka kutoka Yordani karibu na Yeriko, hadi maji ya Yeriko upande wa mashariki, nyika inayopanda kutoka Yeriko kupitia nchi ya milima hadi Betheli.
sw.B: Nchi waliyogawiwa wazao wa Yusufu ilianzia Yordani karibu na Yeriko, mashariki ya chemchemi za Yeriko, ikapita katika nyika inayopanda kutoka Yeriko kuingia nchi ya milima hadi Betheli.
sw.R: Wazao wa Yusufu walipewa nchi yao kwa kura. Mpaka wake wa kusini ulianzia Mto Yordani karibu na Yeriko, mashariki ya chemchemi za huko. Kutoka Yeriko ulipanda kupitia jangwa kuingia nchi ya milima, ukaendelea hadi Betheli.

es.L: Y salió la suerte para los hijos de José desde el Jordán de Jericó, hasta las aguas de Jericó al oriente, el desierto que sube desde Jericó por la región montañosa hasta Betel.
es.B: La porción de los descendientes de José iba desde el Jordán junto a Jericó, al oriente de los manantiales de Jericó, por el desierto que sube desde Jericó hacia la región montañosa hasta Betel.
es.R: Los descendientes de José recibieron su tierra por sorteo. Su frontera sur empezaba en el río Jordán, cerca de Jericó, al este de los manantiales de allí. Desde Jericó subía por el desierto hacia la región montañosa y seguía hasta Betel.

fr.L: Et le sort des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Joseph sortit depuis le Jourdain de Jéricho, vers les eaux de Jéricho à l’orient, le désert qui monte de Jéricho par la montagne vers Béthel.
fr.B: Le territoire échu par le sort aux descendants de Joseph partait du Jourdain, près de Jéricho, à l’est des sources de Jéricho, et suivait le désert qui monte de Jéricho dans la région montagneuse jusqu’à Béthel.
fr.R: Les descendants de Joseph ont reçu leur pays par tirage au sort. Sa frontière sud commençait au Jourdain, près de Jéricho, à l’est des sources de la ville. De Jéricho, elle montait à travers le désert dans la région montagneuse et allait jusqu’à Béthel.

vi.L: Thăm của con cháu Giô-sép đi ra từ sông Giô-đanh tại Giê-ri-cô, đến các dòng nước Giê-ri-cô về phía đông, [qua] đồng hoang đi lên từ Giê-ri-cô qua miền núi đến Bê-tên.
vi.B: Phần đất bắt thăm được cho con cháu Giô-sép chạy từ sông Giô-đanh tại Giê-ri-cô, phía đông các suối nước Giê-ri-cô, qua đồng hoang đi lên từ Giê-ri-cô vào miền núi đến Bê-tên.
vi.R: Con cháu Giô-sép bắt thăm được phần đất của mình. Ranh giới phía nam bắt đầu ở sông Giô-đanh gần Giê-ri-cô, phía đông các suối nước ở đó. Từ Giê-ri-cô nó đi lên qua hoang mạc vào miền núi và đến Bê-tên.

ko.L: 그리고 요셉 자손의 제비가 여리고 곁 요단에서부터 동쪽으로 여리고 물에 이르기까지 나왔으니, 여리고에서 산지를 거쳐 벧엘까지 올라가는 광야이다.
ko.B: 요셉 자손이 제비 뽑아 받은 땅은 여리고 곁의 요단강에서부터 여리고 샘물 동쪽을 거쳐, 여리고에서 산지로 올라가는 광야를 지나 벧엘에 이르렀다.
ko.R: 요셉의 자손은 제비를 뽑아 땅을 받았다. 그 땅의 남쪽 경계는 여리고 근처의 요단강, 곧 여리고 샘물 동쪽에서 시작되었다. 경계는 여리고에서 광야를 지나 산지로 올라가서 벧엘까지 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a sorte para os filhos de José saiu desde o Jordão, [junto a] Jericó, até as águas de Jericó, a leste, o deserto que sobe de Jericó pela região montanhosa até Betel.
pt.B: A parte que coube por sorteio aos descendentes de José ia desde o Jordão, junto a Jericó, a leste das fontes de Jericó, e atravessava o deserto que sobe de Jericó para a região montanhosa, até Betel.
pt.R: Os descendentes de José receberam a sua terra por sorteio. A fronteira sul dela começava no rio Jordão, perto de Jericó, a leste das fontes de lá. De Jericó, ela subia pelo deserto até a região montanhosa e seguia até Betel.

am.L: ለዮሴፍ ልጆች ዕጣው በኢያሪኮ አጠገብ ካለው ከዮርዳኖስ፣ በምሥራቅ በኩል ወዳሉት ወደ ኢያሪኮ ውኆች ወጣ፤ ከኢያሪኮ በኮረብታማው አገር በኩል ወደ ቤቴል የሚወጣው ምድረ በዳ [ነው]።
am.B: ለዮሴፍ ዘሮች የወጣው ድርሻ በኢያሪኮ አጠገብ ካለው ከዮርዳኖስ፣ ከኢያሪኮ ምንጮች በስተ ምሥራቅ ጀምሮ፣ ከኢያሪኮ ወደ ኮረብታማው አገር ሽቅብ በሚወጣው ምድረ በዳ በኩል እስከ ቤቴል ይደርስ ነበር።
am.R: የዮሴፍ ዘሮች ምድራቸውን በዕጣ ተቀበሉ። የደቡብ ድንበሩ በኢያሪኮ አጠገብ ካለው ከዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ፣ ከዚያ ካሉት ምንጮች በስተ ምሥራቅ ጀመረ። ከኢያሪኮም በበረሃው በኩል ወደ ኮረብታማው አገር ወጥቶ እስከ ቤቴል ደረሰ።

decisions.choice: the lot went out: the land fell to them by lot
decisions.reason: Casting lots was the way the land was shared out, so that the choice was left to God (14:2; Numbers 26:55-56; Proverbs 16:33). "The lot went out" means the lot was drawn for them, and the word "lot" then stands for the land it gave: the description that follows is the line of that land.

decisions.choice: the sons of Joseph: the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh together
decisions.reason: Joseph's two sons each became a tribe (verse 4; Genesis 48:5). Here they receive one lot together, and the line traced in verses 1-3 is the southern edge of their whole share. Chapter 16 then gives Ephraim's part (verses 5-10) and chapter 17 Manasseh's.

decisions.choice: the waters of Jericho: the springs at Jericho
decisions.reason: Jericho was an oasis watered by strong springs (2 Kings 2:19-22). The border starts at the Jordan, east of these springs, and runs west. The same line is the northern border of Benjamin (18:12-13).

decisions.choice: the wilderness going up: kept as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: and it went up from Jericho into the wilderness
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence is compressed: "the wilderness" stands without a linking word, describing the dry, rising country the border crosses between Jericho and Bethel (compare 18:12, "the wilderness of Beth-aven"). The ancient Greek translation reads it differently, joining the words to the line of the border. The Hebrew is followed. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: allotment
decisions.reason: Balanced says "allotment" for the share given by lot, since "the lot ran from" would be unclear (m1). Literal keeps "lot"; Readable says they "were given their land by lot".

decisions.choice: Its southern border
decisions.reason: Readable names this as the southern border, which is what verses 1-3 trace (m2), and breaks the sentence into short ones.

decisions.choice: "le sort ... sortit" at Literal
decisions.reason: Hebrew says the lot "went out", the picture of a lot drawn from a container. Literal keeps the verb; French "sortir" can be said of a lot that is drawn ("le numéro qui sort"). Balanced and Readable say the land fell to them by lot.

decisions.choice: "Thăm ... đi ra" at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the lot "went out", meaning the land fell to them by lot (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture, the other levels say it plainly.

decisions.choice: "제비가 ... 나왔으니" (L); "제비 뽑아 받은 땅" (B); "제비를 뽑아 땅을 받았다" (R)
decisions.reason: The lot "went out" for Joseph means the land fell to them by lot (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what was received, and Readable names the southern border, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a sorte ... saiu (L); a parte que coube por sorteio (B); receberam ... por sorteio (R); os filhos de José (L), os descendentes de José (B, R), no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de José
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the lot that "goes out" (m1) with "sair", the ordinary Portuguese verb for a lot that is drawn, as 18:11 has it; Balanced names the share the lot gave, with "caber", as 15:1 does, and Readable says plainly that they received their land by lot. "Os filhos de José" needs no gender setting where the English has one, since "filhos" includes daughters (1:2); the same holds for verses 4, 5, 8 and 9.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "የዮሴፍ ልጆች", "የኤፍሬም ልጆች" (L), "ዘሮች" (B, R)
decisions.reason: ልጆች and ዘሮች already include daughters, as in the Pentateuch, so Amharic has one wording where the English offers two; this holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "the lot went out": "ዕጣው ... ወጣ" (L); "ድርሻ" (allotment, B)
decisions.reason: ዕጣ and ድርሻ are the terms list's words for lot and allotment; Literal keeps the Hebrew verb, as in "ሁለተኛው ዕጣ ... ወጣ" in chapter 19.

source.text: וְיָצָ֥א מִבֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָה וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־גְּב֥וּל הָאַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes out from Bethel to Luz and passes on to [the] territory of the Archite[s] [at] Ataroth.

en.L: And it goes out from Bethel to Luz, and passes along to the territory of the Archites, [to] Ataroth.
en.B: From Bethel it goes on to Luz and passes along to Ataroth, in the territory of the Archites.
en.R: From Bethel it went on to Luz, and then along to the town of Ataroth, where the Archite clan lived.

sw.L: Na unatoka Betheli hadi Luzu, na kupita hadi eneo la Waarki, [hadi] Atarothi.
sw.B: Kutoka Betheli unaendelea hadi Luzu na kupita hadi Atarothi, katika eneo la Waarki.
sw.R: Kutoka Betheli ulienda hadi Luzu, kisha ukaendelea hadi mji wa Atarothi, walikoishi ukoo wa Waarki.

es.L: Y sale de Betel hacia Luz, y pasa al territorio de los arquitas, [a] Atarot.
es.B: De Betel sigue hacia Luz y pasa hasta Atarot, en el territorio de los arquitas.
es.R: De Betel seguía hacia Luz, y luego hasta el pueblo de Atarot, donde vivía el clan de los arquitas.

fr.L: Et elle sort de Béthel vers Louz, et passe vers le territoire des Arkites, [à] Ataroth.
fr.B: De Béthel, elle continue vers Louz et passe vers Ataroth, sur le territoire des Arkites.
fr.R: De Béthel, elle allait jusqu’à Louz, puis jusqu’à la ville d’Ataroth, où vivait le clan des Arkites.

vi.L: Nó đi ra từ Bê-tên đến Lu-xơ, rồi đi qua địa phận người Ạt-kít, [đến] A-ta-rốt.
vi.B: Từ Bê-tên nó đi tiếp đến Lu-xơ rồi chạy qua A-ta-rốt, trong địa phận người Ạt-kít.
vi.R: Từ Bê-tên nó đi đến Lu-xơ, rồi tiếp đến thị trấn A-ta-rốt, nơi gia tộc Ạt-kít sinh sống.

ko.L: 그리고 그것은 벧엘에서 루스로 나가서 아렉 사람의 경계로, 아다롯으로 지나간다.
ko.B: 경계는 벧엘에서 루스로 나가서, 아렉 사람의 지역에 있는 아다롯으로 지나간다.
ko.R: 벧엘에서 경계는 루스로 갔고, 다시 아렉 집안이 사는 아다롯 성읍으로 이어졌다.

pt.L: E sai de Betel para Luz, e passa ao território dos arquitas, [a] Atarote.
pt.B: De Betel segue até Luz e passa para Atarote, no território dos arquitas.
pt.R: De Betel ela seguia até Luz e depois até a cidade de Atarote, onde vivia o clã dos arquitas.

am.L: ከቤቴልም ወደ ሎዛ ይዘልቃል፤ ወደ አርካውያን ግዛት ወደ አጣሮት ያልፋል።
am.B: ከቤቴል ወደ ሎዛ ይዘልቃል፤ በአርካውያን ግዛት ወዳለችው ወደ አጣሮት ያልፋል።
am.R: ከቤቴል ወደ ሎዛ ሄደ፤ ከዚያም የአርካውያን ጎሳ ወደሚኖሩባት ወደ አጣሮት ከተማ አለፈ።

decisions.choice: goes out ... passes: the course of the border, not events in time
decisions.reason: From here on the verbs describe the path the boundary line takes, as one would trace it on a map: it goes out, passes, goes down, ends. The Hebrew form used here, common in boundary lists (15:2-11; 18:12-20), describes a standing fact rather than something that happened once.

decisions.choice: from Bethel to Luz: two neighboring places
alternatives: Luz as another name for Bethel
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Luz is named as the older name of Bethel (Genesis 28:19; Joshua 18:13; Judges 1:23). Here the two are distinct points on the line, probably because the town of Luz and the shrine of Bethel stood a short distance apart; 18:13 also speaks of the line passing "toward Luz, to the side of Luz, that is Bethel".

decisions.choice: the Archites: a clan living near Ataroth
decisions.reason: The Archites are known from David's friend Hushai the Archite (2 Samuel 15:32). Their land lay on this border, near the town of Ataroth, which is probably the Ataroth-addar of verse 5 and 18:13.

decisions.choice: the town of Ataroth, where the Archite clan lived
alternatives: the territory of the Archites at Ataroth
decisions.reason: Readable adds "the town of" and "clan" so the reader can tell the place from the people (terms doc for Joshua's town lists).

decisions.choice: went ... went along
decisions.reason: Readable tells the line in the past tense, as a story of where the border ran, which reads more easily for new readers. Literal and Balanced keep the present that describes a border (m1).

decisions.choice: Luz, os arquitas, Atarote; os jafletitas, Bete-Horom de Baixo, Gezer (verse 3); Atarote-Adar, Bete-Horom de Cima (5); Micmetá, Taanate-Siló, Janoa (6); Naará (7); Tapua, o ribeiro de Caná (8)
decisions.reason: For this chapter: the names in their usual Brazilian forms, as 18:13 has Luz, Atarote-Adar and Bete-Horom de Baixo, with "-ote" for the ending -oth and "de Cima" and "de Baixo" for upper and lower. "Taanate-Siló" keeps the form of Siló (18:1), though it is another place (m2 on verse 6). The clans and places named only here or almost only here, "os jafletitas", "Micmetá", "Taanate-Siló" and "Naará", have no settled Portuguese form and are written by the same pattern; their spelling is uncertain. "Os arquitas" is the people of Hushai "o arquita".

decisions.choice: Luz "ሎዛ"
decisions.reason: The form of Genesis 28:19 and 35:6 on main; 18:13 uses it again.

source.text: וְיָֽרַד־יָ֜מָּה אֶל־גְּב֣וּל הַיַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית־חוֹרֹ֛ן תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְעַד־גָּ֑זֶר וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו יָֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes down westward to [the] territory of the Japhletite[s] as far as [the] territory of Beth-horon lower and as far as Gezer, and are its goings out to the sea.

en.L: And it goes down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon and as far as Gezer, and its end is at the sea.
en.B: Then it goes down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon, and on to Gezer, and it ends at the sea.
en.R: Then it went down west to the land of the Japhletite clan, as far as Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer. It ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

sw.L: Na unashuka kuelekea magharibi hadi eneo la Wayafleti, hadi eneo la Beth-horoni ya Chini na hadi Gezeri, na mwisho wake ni baharini.
sw.B: Kisha unashuka kuelekea magharibi hadi eneo la Wayafleti, hadi eneo la Beth-horoni ya Chini, na kuendelea hadi Gezeri, nao unaishia baharini.
sw.R: Kisha ulishuka kuelekea magharibi hadi nchi ya ukoo wa Wayafleti, hadi Beth-horoni ya Chini, ukaendelea hadi Gezeri. Uliishia Bahari ya Mediterania.

es.L: Y baja al occidente al territorio de los jafletitas, hasta el territorio de Bet-horón de abajo y hasta Gezer, y sus salidas están en el mar.
es.B: Luego baja al occidente hacia el territorio de los jafletitas, hasta el territorio de Bet-horón de abajo, y sigue hasta Gezer, y termina en el mar.
es.R: Después bajaba al oeste hacia la tierra del clan de los jafletitas, hasta Bet-horón de abajo, y seguía hasta Gezer. Terminaba en el mar Mediterráneo.

fr.L: Et elle descend vers l’occident vers le territoire des Japhlétites, jusqu’au territoire de Beth-Horon d’en bas et jusqu’à Guézer, et ses issues sont à la mer.
fr.B: Puis elle descend vers l’ouest jusqu’au territoire des Japhlétites, jusqu’au territoire de Beth-Horon d’en bas, et jusqu’à Guézer, et elle aboutit à la mer.
fr.R: Ensuite, elle descendait vers l’ouest jusqu’au pays du clan des Japhlétites, jusqu’à Beth-Horon d’en bas et jusqu’à Guézer. Elle se terminait à la mer Méditerranée.

vi.L: Nó đi xuống về phía tây đến địa phận người Giáp-lê-tít, cho đến địa phận Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ và cho đến Ghê-xe, và cuối của nó là ở biển.
vi.B: Rồi nó đi xuống về phía tây đến địa phận người Giáp-lê-tít, cho đến địa phận Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ, tiếp đến Ghê-xe, và dừng lại ở biển.
vi.R: Rồi nó đi xuống về phía tây đến đất của gia tộc Giáp-lê-tít, cho đến Bết-Hô-rôn Hạ và tiếp đến Ghê-xe. Nó dừng lại ở Địa Trung Hải.

ko.L: 그리고 그것은 서쪽으로 야블렛 사람의 경계로, 아래 벧호론의 경계까지, 그리고 게셀까지 내려가고, 그 끝은 바다이다.
ko.B: 그다음에 서쪽으로 야블렛 사람의 지역으로 내려가서, 아래 벧호론 지역까지 이르고, 게셀까지 가서 바다에서 끝난다.
ko.R: 그다음에 경계는 서쪽으로 야블렛 집안의 땅으로 내려가서 아래 벧호론까지 이르고, 게셀까지 갔다. 그리고 지중해에서 끝났다.

pt.L: E desce para o oeste, ao território dos jafletitas, até o território de Bete-Horom de Baixo, e até Gezer; e o seu extremo é no mar.
pt.B: Depois desce para o oeste, até o território dos jafletitas e o território de Bete-Horom de Baixo, segue até Gezer e termina no mar.
pt.R: Depois ela descia para o oeste até a terra do clã dos jafletitas, até Bete-Horom de Baixo, e seguia até Gezer. Terminava no mar Mediterrâneo.

am.L: በምዕራብ በኩልም ወደ ያፍሌጣውያን ግዛት፣ እስከ ታችኛው ቤትሖሮን ግዛትና እስከ ጌዝር ድረስ ይወርዳል፤ መጨረሻውም በባሕሩ ነው።
am.B: ከዚያም በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ያፍሌጣውያን ግዛት፣ እስከ ታችኛው ቤትሖሮን ግዛት ድረስ ይወርዳል፤ ወደ ጌዝርም ይዘልቃል፤ በባሕሩም ያበቃል።
am.R: ከዚያም ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ያፍሌጣውያን ጎሳ ምድር፣ እስከ ታችኛው ቤትሖሮን ወረደ፤ ወደ ጌዝርም ሄደ። በሜዲትራኒያን ባሕርም አበቃ።

decisions.choice: the Japhletites: a clan of the region
decisions.reason: The Japhletites are not mentioned anywhere else in the Old Testament. A man named Japhlet appears in the line of Asher (1 Chronicles 7:32-33), but the link is not certain. They were a group living on the border between Bethel and Beth-horon.

decisions.choice: Lower Beth-horon and Gezer: the descent to the coastal plain
decisions.reason: Upper and Lower Beth-horon stood at the top and the foot of the steep pass that leads down from the hill country to the lowland (10:10-11). Gezer lay beyond, at the edge of the plain, guarding the road to the coast.

decisions.choice: its goings out are at the sea: it ends at the Mediterranean
decisions.reason: "Goings out" is the regular word in the boundary lists for the point where a line runs out (15:4, 11). "The sea" on the west is the Mediterranean.

decisions.choice: its end is (L); ends (B); ended (R)
alternatives: its goings out are at the sea
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly that the line ends at the sea (m3). Literal says "its end is at the sea", as in Numbers 34:5 and through these lists.

decisions.choice: the Mediterranean Sea
decisions.reason: Readable gives the modern name of the sea (m3), as in 1:4.

records.literal_gloss: And received inheritance [the] sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.
en.B: So the descendants of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.
en.R: This is how Joseph's descendants, the tribes of Manasseh and Ephraim, received their land.

sw.L: Na wana wa Yusufu, Manase na Efraimu, wakapokea urithi wao.
sw.B: Hivyo wazao wa Yusufu, Manase na Efraimu, walipokea urithi wao.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo wazao wa Yusufu, yaani makabila ya Manase na Efraimu, walivyopokea nchi yao.

es.L: Y recibieron heredad los hijos de José, Manasés y Efraín.
es.B: Así recibieron su heredad los descendientes de José, Manasés y Efraín.
es.R: Así recibieron su tierra los descendientes de José, las tribus de Manasés y Efraín.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Joseph, Manassé et Éphraïm, reçurent leur héritage.
fr.B: Ainsi les descendants de Joseph, Manassé et Éphraïm, reçurent leur héritage.
fr.R: C’est ainsi que les descendants de Joseph, les tribus de Manassé et d’Éphraïm, ont reçu leur terre.

vi.L: Con cháu Giô-sép, Ma-na-se và Ép-ra-im, đã nhận sản nghiệp của họ.
vi.B: Vậy con cháu Giô-sép, là Ma-na-se và Ép-ra-im, đã nhận sản nghiệp của mình.
vi.R: Đó là cách con cháu Giô-sép, tức là các chi tộc Ma-na-se và Ép-ra-im, nhận được đất của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 요셉 자손 므낫세와 에브라임이 그들의 유산을 받았다.
ko.B: 이렇게 요셉 자손, 곧 므낫세와 에브라임이 유산을 받았다.
ko.R: 이렇게 요셉의 자손인 므낫세 지파와 에브라임 지파가 자기 땅을 받았다.

pt.L: E os filhos de José, Manassés e Efraim, receberam a sua herança.
pt.B: Assim os descendentes de José, Manassés e Efraim, receberam a sua herança.
pt.R: Foi assim que os descendentes de José, as tribos de Manassés e de Efraim, receberam a sua terra.

am.L: የዮሴፍም ልጆች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ርስታቸውን ወረሱ።
am.B: ስለዚህ የዮሴፍ ዘሮች ምናሴና ኤፍሬም ርስታቸውን ተቀበሉ።
am.R: የዮሴፍ ዘሮች የምናሴና የኤፍሬም ነገዶች ምድራቸውን የተቀበሉት በዚህ ሁኔታ ነበረ።

decisions.choice: received their inheritance: took possession of land as a lasting family holding
decisions.reason: The verb means to receive or take as an inheritance. The land given by lot was to stay with each tribe and its families for good, passed down from one generation to the next (Numbers 27:8-11; 36:7-9).

decisions.choice: Manasseh and Ephraim: the older son named first
decisions.reason: Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn, and he is named first here, as in Genesis 48:1. Yet Jacob set Ephraim ahead of him (Genesis 48:14-20), and Ephraim's share is described first in the verses that follow.

decisions.choice: the tribes of Manasseh and Ephraim; their land
alternatives: Manasseh and Ephraim received their inheritance
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the two names are tribes, and says "land" for the inheritance (m1).

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָם֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַד־בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] territory of [the] sons of Ephraim by their clans; and was [the] border of their inheritance eastward Ataroth-addar as far as Beth-horon upper.

en.L: And the territory of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ephraim by their clans was [this]: the border of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon.
en.B: This was the territory of the Ephraimites, clan by clan. The border of their inheritance ran on the east from Ataroth-addar to Upper Beth-horon,
en.R: Here is the land of the tribe of Ephraim, family by family. The border of their land started on the east at Ataroth-addar and ran to Upper Beth-horon.

sw.L: Na eneo la wana wa Efraimu kufuatana na koo zao [lilikuwa hili]: mpaka wa urithi wao upande wa mashariki ulikuwa Atarothi-adari hadi Beth-horoni ya Juu.
sw.B: Hili ndilo lililokuwa eneo la Waefraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo. Mpaka wa urithi wao upande wa mashariki ulianzia Atarothi-adari hadi Beth-horoni ya Juu,
sw.R: Hii ndiyo nchi ya kabila la Efraimu, jamaa kwa jamaa. Mpaka wa nchi yao ulianzia upande wa mashariki huko Atarothi-adari, ukaenda hadi Beth-horoni ya Juu.

es.L: Y el territorio de los hijos de Efraín conforme a sus clanes fue [este]: la frontera de su heredad al oriente fue Atarot-adar hasta Bet-horón de arriba.
es.B: Este fue el territorio de los efraimitas, clan por clan. La frontera de su heredad iba por el oriente desde Atarot-adar hasta Bet-horón de arriba,
es.R: Esta es la tierra de la tribu de Efraín, familia por familia. La frontera de su tierra empezaba por el este en Atarot-adar y llegaba hasta Bet-horón de arriba.

fr.L: Et le territoire des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Éphraïm selon leurs clans fut [ceci] : la frontière de leur héritage, à l’orient, fut Ataroth-Addar jusqu’à Beth-Horon d’en haut.
fr.B: Voici le territoire des Éphraïmites, clan par clan. À l’est, la frontière de leur héritage va d’Ataroth-Addar jusqu’à Beth-Horon d’en haut,
fr.R: Voici le pays de la tribu d’Éphraïm, famille par famille. À l’est, la frontière de leur pays commençait à Ataroth-Addar et allait jusqu’à Beth-Horon d’en haut.

vi.L: Địa phận của con cháu Ép-ra-im theo các gia tộc của họ [là thế này]: ranh giới sản nghiệp của họ về phía đông là A-ta-rốt-Át-đa cho đến Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng.
vi.B: Đây là địa phận của người Ép-ra-im, theo từng gia tộc. Ranh giới sản nghiệp của họ về phía đông chạy từ A-ta-rốt-Át-đa đến Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng,
vi.R: Đây là đất của chi tộc Ép-ra-im, theo từng gia đình. Ranh giới đất của họ bắt đầu ở phía đông tại A-ta-rốt-Át-đa và chạy đến Bết-Hô-rôn Thượng.

ko.L: 그리고 에브라임 자손의 그들의 종족대로의 지역은 [이러하다]. 그들의 유산의 경계는 동쪽으로 아다롯 앗달에서 위 벧호론까지이다.
ko.B: 에브라임 자손이 종족별로 받은 지역은 이러하다. 그들의 유산의 경계는 동쪽으로 아다롯 앗달에서 위 벧호론까지 이르고,
ko.R: 에브라임 지파가 집안별로 받은 땅은 이러하다. 그들 땅의 경계는 동쪽의 아다롯 앗달에서 시작하여 위 벧호론까지 이어졌다.

pt.L: E o território dos filhos de Efraim, segundo os seus clãs, era [este]: a fronteira da herança deles, a leste, era Atarote-Adar até Bete-Horom de Cima.
pt.B: Este era o território dos efraimitas, clã por clã. A fronteira da herança deles ia, a leste, desde Atarote-Adar até Bete-Horom de Cima,
pt.R: Esta é a terra da tribo de Efraim, família por família. A fronteira da terra deles começava a leste, em Atarote-Adar, e ia até Bete-Horom de Cima.

am.L: የኤፍሬም ልጆች ግዛት በየጎሳቸው [ይህ] ነበረ፤ የርስታቸው ድንበር በምሥራቅ በኩል ከአጣሮትአዳር እስከ ላይኛው ቤትሖሮን ድረስ ነበረ።
am.B: የኤፍሬም ነገድ ግዛት በየጎሳቸው ይህ ነበረ። የርስታቸው ድንበር በምሥራቅ በኩል ከአጣሮትአዳር እስከ ላይኛው ቤትሖሮን ይዘልቃል፤
am.R: የኤፍሬም ነገድ ምድር በየጎሳቸው ይህ ነው። የምድራቸው ድንበር በምሥራቅ በኩል ከአጣሮትአዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ላይኛው ቤትሖሮን ዘለቀ።

decisions.choice: on the east, Ataroth-addar to Upper Beth-horon: the southern line seen from its east end
decisions.reason: This is the same southern border as verses 1-3, given more briefly, from Ataroth-addar on its eastern part to Upper Beth-horon on the west (compare 18:13). "On the east" marks where the description begins.

decisions.choice: Ataroth-addar: a border town
decisions.reason: Ataroth-addar is probably the Ataroth of verse 2, named more fully. It stood on the line between Ephraim and Benjamin (18:13). It is a different place from the Ataroth of verse 7, on the eastern side.

decisions.choice: the Ephraimites
decisions.reason: Balanced says "the Ephraimites" for "the sons of Ephraim", a word that already includes the whole tribe, as "Israelites" does for "the sons of Israel" (terms doc). Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: ran ... to Upper Beth-horon, (comma)
decisions.reason: Balanced ends the record with a comma and runs into verse 6, which continues the same description of the border.

decisions.choice: os efraimitas (B); os manassitas (B, verse 9)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the tribal names where the English says "the Ephraimites" and "the Manassites" (r-en-1), in lowercase like "os israelitas" and "os rubenitas" (1:12). Literal keeps "os filhos de Efraim".

source.text: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל הַיָּ֗מָּה הַֽמִּכְמְתָת֙ מִצָּפ֔וֹן וְנָסַ֧ב הַגְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְעָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔וֹ מִמִּזְרַ֖ח יָנֽוֹחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes out the border to the sea; the Michmethath on [the] north; and turns the border eastward [to] Taanath-shiloh and passes it on [the] east [to] Janoah.

en.L: And the border goes out toward the sea, the Michmethath being on the north, and the border turns eastward to Taanath-shiloh and passes by it on the east to Janoah.
en.B: and out to the sea. From Michmethath on the north the border turns east toward Taanath-shiloh and passes by it on the east to Janoah.
en.R: From there the border went west to the sea. On the north side, it started at Michmethath, turned east toward Taanath-shiloh, and passed east of it to Janoah.

sw.L: Na mpaka unatokea kuelekea baharini, Mikmethathi ikiwa upande wa kaskazini; na mpaka unageuka kuelekea mashariki hadi Taanath-shilo na kuupita upande wa mashariki hadi Yanoa.
sw.B: na kutokea baharini. Kutoka Mikmethathi upande wa kaskazini mpaka unageuka kuelekea mashariki hadi Taanath-shilo, na kuupita upande wa mashariki hadi Yanoa.
sw.R: Kutoka hapo mpaka ulienda magharibi hadi baharini. Upande wa kaskazini ulianzia Mikmethathi, ukageuka kuelekea mashariki hadi Taanath-shilo, ukaupita upande wa mashariki hadi Yanoa.

es.L: Y sale la frontera hacia el mar, estando Micmetat al norte; y gira la frontera al oriente hacia Taanat-silo, y pasa por ella al oriente hasta Janoa.
es.B: y sale hasta el mar. Desde Micmetat, al norte, la frontera gira al oriente hacia Taanat-silo y pasa por su lado oriental hasta Janoa.
es.R: Desde allí la frontera iba al oeste hasta el mar. Por el lado norte, empezaba en Micmetat, giraba al este hacia Taanat-silo y pasaba al este de ella hasta Janoa.

fr.L: Et la frontière sort vers la mer, Mikmethath étant au nord ; et la frontière tourne vers l’orient vers Taanath-Silo et la passe à l’orient vers Janoah.
fr.B: et sort vers la mer. Depuis Mikmethath, au nord, la frontière tourne vers l’est jusqu’à Taanath-Silo, et la dépasse à l’est vers Janoah.
fr.R: De là, la frontière allait vers l’ouest, jusqu’à la mer. Du côté nord, elle commençait à Mikmethath, tournait vers l’est jusqu’à Taanath-Silo et passait à l’est de cette ville jusqu’à Janoah.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi ra về phía biển, Mích-mê-thát ở phía bắc; và ranh giới vòng về phía đông đến Tha-a-nát-Si-lô và đi ngang qua nó về phía đông đến Gia-nô-a.
vi.B: rồi ra đến biển. Từ Mích-mê-thát ở phía bắc, ranh giới vòng về phía đông hướng Tha-a-nát-Si-lô và đi ngang qua phía đông thành ấy đến Gia-nô-a.
vi.R: Từ đó ranh giới đi về phía tây ra đến biển. Ở phía bắc, nó bắt đầu tại Mích-mê-thát, vòng về phía đông hướng Tha-a-nát-Si-lô, và đi qua phía đông thành ấy đến Gia-nô-a.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 바다 쪽으로 나가니, 믹므다는 북쪽에 있다. 그리고 경계는 동쪽으로 다아낫 실로로 돌아서 그것을 동쪽으로 지나 야노아로 간다.
ko.B: 바다까지 나간다. 북쪽의 믹므다에서 경계는 동쪽으로 다아낫 실로를 향해 돌아서, 그 동쪽을 지나 야노아에 이른다.
ko.R: 거기에서 경계는 서쪽으로 바다까지 갔다. 북쪽 경계는 믹므다에서 시작하여 동쪽으로 다아낫 실로를 향해 돌았고, 그 동쪽을 지나 야노아에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sai para o mar, Micmetá ao norte; e a fronteira dá a volta para o leste, até Taanate-Siló, e passa por ela, a leste, até Janoa.
pt.B: e sai até o mar. De Micmetá, ao norte, a fronteira vira para o leste, em direção a Taanate-Siló, e passa por ela, pelo lado leste, até Janoa.
pt.R: Dali a fronteira seguia para o oeste até o mar. No lado norte, ela começava em Micmetá, virava para o leste em direção a Taanate-Siló e passava a leste dela até Janoa.

am.L: ድንበሩም ወደ ባሕሩ ይዘልቃል፤ ሚክምታት በሰሜን በኩል [ነው]፤ ድንበሩም በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ታአናትሴሎ ይታጠፋል፤ በምሥራቅ በኩልም እርሷን አልፎ ወደ ያኖዋ ይሄዳል።
am.B: ከዚያም ወደ ባሕሩ ይዘልቃል። በሰሜን በኩል ከሚክምታት ድንበሩ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ታአናትሴሎ ይታጠፋል፤ በምሥራቅ በኩሏ አልፎ ወደ ያኖዋ ይሄዳል።
am.R: ከዚያም ድንበሩ ወደ ምዕራብ ወደ ባሕሩ ሄደ። በሰሜን በኩል ደግሞ ከሚክምታት ጀምሮ ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ታአናትሴሎ ታጠፈ፤ ከእርሷም በስተ ምሥራቅ አልፎ ወደ ያኖዋ ሄደ።

decisions.choice: goes out to the sea; Michmethath on the north: two parts of the line meeting at Michmethath
alternatives: the border goes from Michmethath on the north to the sea
decisions.reason: The verse is hard to follow. It seems to finish the southern line westward "to the sea", and then to start the northern border at Michmethath, a point near Shechem (17:7), tracing it first eastward (verses 6-7) and then westward from Tappuah (verse 8). Another way to read it is that the line goes west to the sea from Michmethath itself. Either way, Michmethath is a point on Ephraim's northern border.

decisions.choice: Taanath-shiloh and Janoah: towns east and south-east of Shechem
decisions.reason: Taanath-shiloh lay east of Shechem; it is a different place from Shiloh, where the tabernacle was set up (18:1). Janoah lay further to the south-east, on the way down toward the Jordan valley.

decisions.choice: and out to the sea.
decisions.reason: Balanced finishes the sentence begun in verse 5 here, then starts a new sentence for the northern line (m1).

decisions.choice: On the north side, it started at Michmethath
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that a second part of the border starts here (m1). Since the reading is not certain, this is marked for reviewers.

en.L: And it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, and touches Jericho, and goes out at the Jordan.
en.B: From Janoah it goes down to Ataroth and Naarah, reaches Jericho, and comes out at the Jordan.
en.R: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, reached Jericho, and ended at the Jordan River.

sw.L: Na unashuka kutoka Yanoa hadi Atarothi na hadi Naara, na kugusa Yeriko, na kutokea Yordani.

es.R: De Janoa bajaba a Atarot y Naara, llegaba a Jericó y terminaba en el río Jordán.

fr.R: De Janoah, elle descendait jusqu’à Ataroth et Naara, arrivait à Jéricho et se terminait au Jourdain.

vi.L: Nó đi xuống từ Gia-nô-a đến A-ta-rốt và đến Na-a-ra, chạm Giê-ri-cô, và đi ra ở sông Giô-đanh.

vi.R: Từ Gia-nô-a nó đi xuống A-ta-rốt và Na-a-ra, đến Giê-ri-cô, và dừng lại ở sông Giô-đanh.

ko.L: 그리고 그것은 야노아에서 아다롯과 나아라로 내려가서 여리고에 닿고 요단으로 나간다.
ko.B: 경계는 야노아에서 아다롯과 나아라로 내려가서 여리고에 이르고 요단강으로 나간다.
ko.R: 경계는 야노아에서 아다롯과 나아라로 내려가서 여리고에 이르렀고, 요단강에서 끝났다.

pt.L: E desce de Janoa a Atarote e a Naará, e toca Jericó, e sai no Jordão.
pt.B: De Janoa desce até Atarote e Naará, chega a Jericó e termina no Jordão.
pt.R: De Janoa ela descia até Atarote e Naará, chegava a Jericó e terminava no rio Jordão.

am.L: ከያኖዋም ወደ አጣሮትና ወደ ነዓራ ይወርዳል፤ ኢያሪኮንም ይነካል፤ በዮርዳኖስም ይዘልቃል።
am.B: ከያኖዋ ወደ አጣሮትና ወደ ነዓራ ይወርዳል፤ ኢያሪኮ ደርሶ በዮርዳኖስ ያበቃል።
am.R: ከያኖዋ ወደ አጣሮትና ወደ ነዓራ ወረደ፤ ኢያሪኮ ደርሶ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አበቃ።

decisions.choice: Ataroth and Naarah: places on the descent to the Jordan valley
decisions.reason: This Ataroth is in the east, below Janoah, and is not the Ataroth of verse 2. Naarah is probably the Naaran of 1 Chronicles 7:28, a town of Ephraim north of Jericho.

decisions.choice: touches Jericho: reaches the area of Jericho
decisions.reason: The verb means to meet or touch. The line comes down to the region of Jericho, which itself belonged to Benjamin (18:21), and then reaches the Jordan. So the eastern end of Ephraim's land is closed off near where the southern line began (verse 1).

decisions.choice: reaches
decisions.reason: "Touches" is kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "reaches", which is how a border is described in English.

decisions.choice: toca (L); chega a (B), chegava a (R); sai no Jordão (L), termina no Jordão (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "tocar", the verb's first sense (m2), as the English Literal keeps "touches"; Balanced and Readable say "chegar a" (r-en-1). The line runs out at the Jordan, so Balanced and Readable close it with "termina", as the boundary formula has it (15:3).

source.text: מִתַּפּ֜וּחַ יֵלֵ֨ךְ הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֨מָּה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּ֑מָּה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From Tappuah goes the border westward [the] wadi [of] Kanah, and are its goings out to the sea. This [is the] inheritance of [the] tribe of [the] sons of Ephraim by their clans,

en.L: From Tappuah the border goes westward [to] the wadi of Kanah, and its end is at the sea. This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ephraim by their clans,
en.B: From Tappuah the border goes west along the Wadi Kanah and ends at the sea. This is the inheritance of the Ephraimite tribe, clan by clan,
en.R: On the west side, the border went from Tappuah along the Wadi Kanah, a stream that is dry most of the year, and ended at the sea. This was the land given to the tribe of Ephraim, family by family.

sw.L: Kutoka Tapua mpaka unaenda kuelekea magharibi [hadi] korongo la Kana, na mwisho wake ni baharini. Huu [ndio] urithi wa kabila la wana wa Efraimu kufuatana na koo zao,
sw.B: Kutoka Tapua mpaka unaenda magharibi kando ya Bonde la Kana na kuishia baharini. Huu ndio urithi wa kabila la Efraimu, ukoo kwa ukoo,
sw.R: Upande wa magharibi, mpaka ulienda kutoka Tapua kando ya Bonde la Kana, mkondo ambao huwa mkavu karibu mwaka mzima, ukaishia baharini. Hii ndiyo nchi iliyopewa kabila la Efraimu, jamaa kwa jamaa.

es.L: Desde Tapúa va la frontera al occidente [hasta] el torrente de Caná, y sus salidas están en el mar. Esta [es] la heredad de la tribu de los hijos de Efraín conforme a sus clanes,
es.B: Desde Tapúa la frontera va al occidente por el torrente de Caná y termina en el mar. Esta es la heredad de la tribu de los efraimitas, clan por clan,
es.R: Por el lado oeste, la frontera iba desde Tapúa por el torrente de Caná, un arroyo que está seco casi todo el año, y terminaba en el mar. Esta fue la tierra que se dio a la tribu de Efraín, familia por familia.

fr.L: De Tappouah, la frontière va vers l’occident, [vers] le torrent de Kana, et ses issues sont à la mer. Ceci [est] l’héritage de la tribu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Éphraïm selon leurs clans,
fr.B: De Tappouah, la frontière va vers l’ouest le long du torrent de Kana et aboutit à la mer. Tel est l’héritage de la tribu des Éphraïmites, clan par clan,
fr.R: Du côté ouest, la frontière allait de Tappouah le long du torrent de Kana, un cours d’eau à sec la plus grande partie de l’année, et se terminait à la mer. Voilà le pays donné à la tribu d’Éphraïm, famille par famille.

vi.L: Từ Tháp-bu-a ranh giới đi về phía tây [đến] khe Ca-na, và cuối của nó là ở biển. Đây [là] sản nghiệp của chi tộc con cháu Ép-ra-im theo các gia tộc của họ,
vi.B: Từ Tháp-bu-a ranh giới đi về phía tây dọc theo khe Ca-na và dừng lại ở biển. Đây là sản nghiệp của chi tộc Ép-ra-im, theo từng gia tộc,
vi.R: Ở phía tây, ranh giới chạy từ Tháp-bu-a dọc theo khe Ca-na, một dòng suối khô cạn gần như quanh năm, rồi dừng lại ở biển. Đó là phần đất được ban cho chi tộc Ép-ra-im, theo từng gia đình.

ko.L: 답부아에서 경계는 서쪽으로 가나 시내로 가고, 그 끝은 바다이다. 이것이 에브라임 자손 지파의 그들의 종족대로의 유산이다.
ko.B: 답부아에서 경계는 서쪽으로 가나 시내를 따라가서 바다에서 끝난다. 이것이 에브라임 지파가 종족별로 받은 유산이고,
ko.R: 서쪽에서는 경계가 답부아에서 가나 시내를 따라갔다. 그 시내는 한 해의 대부분 말라 있다. 경계는 바다에서 끝났다. 이것이 에브라임 지파가 집안별로 받은 땅이다.

pt.L: Desde Tapua a fronteira vai para o oeste, [até] o ribeiro de Caná, e o seu extremo é no mar. Esta [é] a herança da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, segundo os seus clãs,
pt.B: De Tapua a fronteira vai para o oeste, ao longo do ribeiro de Caná, e termina no mar. Esta é a herança da tribo dos efraimitas, clã por clã,
pt.R: No lado oeste, a fronteira ia de Tapua ao longo do ribeiro de Caná, um riacho que fica seco a maior parte do ano, e terminava no mar. Essa foi a terra dada à tribo de Efraim, família por família.

am.L: ድንበሩ ከታጱዋ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ቃና ወንዝ ይሄዳል፤ መጨረሻውም በባሕሩ ነው። የኤፍሬም ልጆች ነገድ ርስት በየጎሳቸው ይህ ነው፤
am.B: ድንበሩ ከታጱዋ በምዕራብ በኩል በቃና ደረቅ ወንዝ አጠገብ ሄዶ በባሕሩ ያበቃል። የኤፍሬም ነገድ በየጎሳቸው የተቀበሉት ርስት ይህ ነው፤
am.R: በምዕራብ በኩል ድንበሩ ከታጱዋ ተነሥቶ በቃና ደረቅ ወንዝ አጠገብ ሄደ፤ ይህ ደረቅ ወንዝ በዓመቱ አብዛኛ ጊዜ ውኃ የለበትም። በባሕሩም አበቃ። የኤፍሬም ነገድ በየጎሳቸው የተቀበሉት የምድር ድርሻ ይህ ነው።

decisions.choice: Tappuah and the wadi of Kanah: the western half of the northern border
decisions.reason: Having traced the northern line eastward from Michmethath (verses 6-7), the text now traces it westward. Tappuah lay on the border with Manasseh (17:7-8). A wadi is a stream bed that is dry most of the year and fills in the rainy season; the Kanah runs west toward the coast and also marks the line between Ephraim and Manasseh in 17:9.

decisions.choice: This is the inheritance ... (continued in verse 9)
alternatives: a full stop at the end of verse 8
decisions.reason: The summary may close the description, or may run on into verse 9: "... by their clans, together with the cities set apart". Literal and Balanced end with a comma to leave that link open.

decisions.choice: wadi of Kanah (L); the Wadi Kanah (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "wadi"; Balanced and Readable use it as part of the name, as with the Wadi of Egypt (15:4), and Readable explains it (m1). The same wording is used in 17:9.

decisions.choice: On the west side
decisions.reason: Readable tells the reader that the description has moved to the western part of the northern border (m1).

decisions.choice: o ribeiro de Caná (every level)
decisions.reason: For chapters 16-17 (also 17:9). The wadi is "o ribeiro", as Numbers 34:5 sets for "o ribeiro do Egito", at every level where the English moves from "wadi of Kanah" to "the Wadi Kanah"; Readable explains it as the English does (m1). "Caná" is the usual Brazilian form of the name, here a stream in the hills, not the village of John 2.

source.text: וְהֶעָרִ֗ים הַמִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כָּֽל־הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: and the cities the set apart for [the] sons of Ephraim in [the] midst of [the] inheritance of [the] sons of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.

en.L: and the cities set apart for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ephraim [were] in the midst of the inheritance of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Manasseh, all the cities and their villages.
en.B: together with the towns set apart for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites, all those towns and their villages.
en.R: The people of Ephraim were also given some towns inside the land of Manasseh, with all the villages around them.

sw.L: na miji iliyotengwa kwa ajili ya wana wa Efraimu [ilikuwa] katikati ya urithi wa wana wa Manase, miji yote na vijiji vyake.
sw.B: pamoja na miji iliyotengwa kwa ajili ya Waefraimu ndani ya urithi wa Wamanase, miji hiyo yote na vijiji vyake.
sw.R: Watu wa Efraimu walipewa pia miji kadhaa ndani ya nchi ya Manase, pamoja na vijiji vyote vilivyoizunguka.

es.L: y las ciudades apartadas para los hijos de Efraín [estaban] en medio de la heredad de los hijos de Manasés, todas las ciudades y sus aldeas.
es.B: junto con las poblaciones apartadas para los efraimitas dentro de la heredad de los manasitas, todas esas poblaciones y sus aldeas.
es.R: La gente de Efraín también recibió algunos pueblos dentro de la tierra de Manasés, con todas las aldeas de alrededor.

fr.L: et les villes réservées aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Éphraïm [étaient] au milieu de l’héritage des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Manassé, toutes les villes et leurs villages.
fr.B: avec les villes réservées aux Éphraïmites au milieu de l’héritage des Manassites, toutes ces villes et leurs villages.
fr.R: Les gens d’Éphraïm ont aussi reçu quelques villes à l’intérieur du pays de Manassé, avec tous les villages qui les entourent.

vi.L: và các thành được để riêng cho con cháu Ép-ra-im [ở] giữa sản nghiệp của con cháu Ma-na-se, tất cả các thành và làng mạc của chúng.
vi.B: cùng với các thị trấn được để riêng cho người Ép-ra-im ở giữa sản nghiệp của người Ma-na-se, tất cả các thị trấn ấy và làng mạc của chúng.
vi.R: Người Ép-ra-im cũng được ban một số thị trấn ở trong đất Ma-na-se, cùng tất cả các làng chung quanh.

ko.L: 그리고 에브라임 자손을 위하여 구별된 성읍들은 므낫세 자손의 유산 가운데 [있었으니], 모든 성읍과 그 마을들이다.
ko.B: 므낫세 자손의 유산 가운데에서 에브라임 자손을 위하여 따로 떼어 둔 성읍들, 곧 그 모든 성읍과 그 마을들도 그들의 것이었다.
ko.R: 에브라임 지파는 므낫세 지파의 땅 안에서도 몇몇 성읍과 그 주변의 모든 마을을 받았다.

pt.L: e as cidades separadas para os filhos de Efraim [estavam] no meio da herança dos filhos de Manassés, todas as cidades e as suas aldeias.
pt.B: além das cidades separadas para os efraimitas dentro da herança dos manassitas, todas essas cidades com as suas aldeias.
pt.R: O povo de Efraim também recebeu algumas cidades dentro da terra de Manassés, com todas as aldeias ao redor delas.

am.L: ለኤፍሬም ልጆች የተለዩት ከተሞችም በምናሴ ልጆች ርስት መካከል [ነበሩ]፤ ከተሞቹ ሁሉና መንደሮቻቸው።

decisions.choice: the cities set apart: towns reserved for Ephraim
decisions.reason: The word describes something separated or set aside. These towns stood inside Manasseh's land but were reserved for Ephraim. Chapter 17 shows the same kind of arrangement: the town of Tappuah belonged to Ephraim while the land around it belonged to Manasseh (17:8-9).

decisions.choice: and the cities ...: a phrase continuing verse 8
alternatives: a separate statement: the cities were in Manasseh's inheritance
decisions.reason: The verse has no main verb of its own. It adds the reserved towns to Ephraim's inheritance just summed up in verse 8.

decisions.choice: their villages: the unwalled settlements belonging to each town
decisions.reason: A walled town had smaller open settlements around it that depended on it and were counted with it, as in the lists of chapter 15.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "towns" for places of this size, as in the other town lists of Joshua; Literal keeps "cities".

decisions.choice: the Manassites
decisions.reason: As "the Ephraimites" in verse 5, Balanced uses the tribal name for "the sons of Manasseh".

records.literal_gloss: And not they dispossessed the Canaanite[s] dwelling in Gezer; and dwelt the Canaanite[s] in [the] midst of Ephraim until the day the this, and became forced labor working.

en.L: But they did not dispossess the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, and the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and they became forced labor, working.
en.B: But they did not drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, and so Canaanites have lived among the Ephraimites to this day, though they were made to work as forced laborers.
en.R: But the people of Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in the town of Gezer. Those Canaanites still live among them today, but they have to do hard work for Ephraim.

sw.L: Lakini hawakuwafukuza Wakanaani waliokaa Gezeri, na Wakanaani wamekaa katikati ya Efraimu hadi siku hii ya leo, nao wakawa watu wa kazi ya kulazimishwa, wakifanya kazi.
sw.B: Lakini hawakuwafukuza Wakanaani walioishi Gezeri, na kwa hiyo Wakanaani wameishi kati ya Waefraimu mpaka leo, ingawa walilazimishwa kufanya kazi za kutumikishwa.
sw.R: Lakini watu wa Efraimu hawakuwafukuza Wakanaani walioishi katika mji wa Gezeri. Wakanaani hao bado wanaishi kati yao hata leo, lakini wanalazimika kufanya kazi ngumu kwa ajili ya Efraimu.

es.L: Pero no desposeyeron a los cananeos que habitaban en Gezer; y los cananeos han habitado en medio de Efraín hasta el día de hoy, y quedaron sujetos a trabajo forzado.
es.B: Pero no expulsaron a los cananeos que vivían en Gezer, y por eso hay cananeos que viven entre los efraimitas hasta el día de hoy, aunque fueron obligados a hacer trabajos forzados.
es.R: Pero la gente de Efraín no echó a los cananeos que vivían en el pueblo de Gezer. Esos cananeos todavía viven entre ellos hoy, pero tienen que hacer trabajos pesados para Efraín.

fr.L: Mais ils ne dépossédèrent pas les Cananéens qui habitaient à Guézer, et les Cananéens ont habité au milieu d’Éphraïm jusqu’à ce jour, et ils sont devenus des corvéables, travaillant.
fr.B: Mais ils ne chassèrent pas les Cananéens qui habitaient à Guézer, si bien que des Cananéens habitent au milieu des Éphraïmites jusqu’à ce jour ; mais ils furent astreints aux travaux forcés.
fr.R: Mais les gens d’Éphraïm n’ont pas chassé les Cananéens qui habitaient dans la ville de Guézer. Ces Cananéens vivent encore aujourd’hui au milieu d’eux, mais ils doivent faire de durs travaux pour Éphraïm.

vi.L: Nhưng họ không đuổi người Ca-na-an sống tại Ghê-xe đi, nên người Ca-na-an sống giữa Ép-ra-im cho đến ngày nay, và họ trở thành người lao dịch, làm việc khổ sai.
vi.B: Nhưng họ không đuổi người Ca-na-an sống tại Ghê-xe đi, nên người Ca-na-an vẫn sống giữa người Ép-ra-im cho đến ngày nay, nhưng bị bắt làm lao dịch.
vi.R: Nhưng người Ép-ra-im không đuổi người Ca-na-an sống tại thị trấn Ghê-xe đi. Những người Ca-na-an ấy vẫn còn sống giữa họ cho đến ngày nay, nhưng phải làm công việc nặng nhọc cho Ép-ra-im.

ko.L: 그러나 그들이 게셀에 사는 가나안 사람을 쫓아내지 않았다. 그리고 가나안 사람이 오늘까지 에브라임 가운데 살면서 강제 노역을 하는 일꾼이 되었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 게셀에 사는 가나안 사람들을 쫓아내지 않았다. 그래서 가나안 사람들은 오늘까지 에브라임 가운데서 살고 있으나, 강제 노역을 하는 일꾼이 되었다.
ko.R: 그러나 에브라임 사람들은 게셀 성읍에 사는 가나안 사람들을 쫓아내지 않았다. 그 가나안 사람들은 지금도 그들 가운데서 살고 있다. 그러나 그들은 에브라임을 위해 힘든 일을 해야 한다.

pt.L: E não desapossaram os cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; e os cananeus habitam no meio de Efraim até este dia, e se tornaram trabalhadores forçados, servindo.
pt.B: Mas não expulsaram os cananeus que viviam em Gezer, e por isso há cananeus vivendo no meio dos efraimitas até hoje, embora tenham sido obrigados a trabalhos forçados.
pt.R: Mas o povo de Efraim não expulsou os cananeus que moravam na cidade de Gezer. Esses cananeus ainda vivem no meio deles até hoje, mas têm de fazer trabalhos pesados para Efraim.

am.L: በጌዝር የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ግን አላስለቀቋቸውም፤ ከነዓናውያንም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በኤፍሬም መካከል ተቀምጠዋል፤ የሚያገለግሉ የግዳጅ ሠራተኞችም ሆኑ።
am.B: በጌዝር የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ግን አላባረሯቸውም፤ ስለዚህ ከነዓናውያን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በኤፍሬማውያን መካከል ይኖራሉ፤ ነገር ግን የግዳጅ ሥራ እንዲሠሩ ተደርገዋል።
am.R: የኤፍሬም ሰዎች ግን በጌዝር ከተማ የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን አላባረሯቸውም። እነዚያ ከነዓናውያን ዛሬም በመካከላቸው ይኖራሉ፤ ነገር ግን ለኤፍሬም ሰዎች የጉልበት ሥራ እንዲሠሩ ይገደዳሉ።

decisions.choice: did not dispossess: did not drive out
decisions.reason: The verb, used for nations, means to drive them out so as to take their land. God had commanded that the Canaanites be driven out (Numbers 33:52-53; Deuteronomy 7:1-2). The note that Ephraim failed to do so at Gezer is repeated in Judges 1:29, and similar notes follow for Manasseh (17:12-13) and Judah (15:63).

decisions.choice: to this day: up to the time the book was written
decisions.reason: The phrase looks from the writer's own day, when Canaanites still lived at Gezer. Later Gezer was captured by a king of Egypt and given to Solomon as a dowry (1 Kings 9:16).

decisions.choice: forced labor, working: a labor force made to serve
decisions.reason: The word means a body of people required to work for others, and "working" stresses that it was hard labor service. The same was done to the Canaanites in other places (17:13; Judges 1:28-35), and Solomon later made such people serve him (1 Kings 9:20-21).

decisions.choice: no additional words: the Hebrew text followed
alternatives: include the Greek addition about Pharaoh
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation adds a sentence saying that Pharaoh king of Egypt went up, captured Gezer and burned it, which agrees with 1 Kings 9:16. The Hebrew text is followed. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: drive out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "drive out" for nations (terms doc for this verb); Literal keeps "dispossess".

decisions.choice: the people of Ephraim; the town of
decisions.reason: Readable names who failed to drive the Canaanites out, and adds "the town of" before Gezer.

decisions.choice: "trabajo forzado" (L); "trabajos forzados" (B); "trabajos pesados" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a gang of forced laborers; Spanish says it plainly. "Tributario", found in older Spanish Bibles, today suggests paying taxes, which is not what is meant.

decisions.choice: "des corvéables" (L), "astreints aux travaux forcés" (B), "faire de durs travaux" (R)
decisions.reason: The mas was labour a ruling people demanded from a subject people. French "corvée" is the old word for unpaid labour owed to a lord; Balanced says "travaux forcés", as the English "forced labor"; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "lao dịch" for forced labor (Literal, Balanced); "công việc nặng nhọc" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "lao dịch" is the work a ruler demands of a subject people; Readable uses plain words.

decisions.choice: "강제 노역을 하는 일꾼" (L, B); "힘든 일을 해야 한다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a labour gang made to work for others (meaning decision m3). "강제 노역" says that the work was imposed without making them slaves in name.

decisions.choice: trabalhadores forçados, servindo (L); obrigados a trabalhos forçados (B); têm de fazer trabalhos pesados (R)
decisions.reason: For chapters 16-17 (also 17:13): the word is a labor force made to work for others (m3). "Trabalhos forçados" is the Portuguese phrase for it; "escravos" would say more than the text, and the old "tributários" would suggest paying tribute. Literal keeps "servindo" for the participle; Readable says it plainly, as the English does. "Desapossar" (L) and "expulsar" (B, R) follow 13:6, and "até este dia" (L) and "até hoje" (B, R) follow 4:9.

decisions.choice: forced labor (mas): "የግዳጅ ሠራተኞች" (L), "የግዳጅ ሥራ" (B), "የጉልበት ሥራ እንዲሠሩ ይገደዳሉ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of a labor levy, not of slaves bought and sold, so ባሪያ is avoided; 17:13 uses the same words.
